binding_constraints_on_any_next_hypothes: The 2022-2024 OKX/Binance 5m window is now CONSUMED for the 24h direction-aligned MAE target by MARKET-06; it must not be silently reused for a variant of that target.
Protected 2025/2026 remain unopened and require separate explicit authorization.
No new hypothesis may be a parameter variant, sign flip, venue swap, horizon tweak, or threshold change of MARKET-01..MARKET-06.
R-F carries the highest rescue risk and must never be used to re-interrogate the MARKET-06 target on the consumed window.

correction.what_was_overstated: Version 1.0.0 claimed that 'three materially different information sources (derivative positioning, cross-asset, cross-venue) produced nulls at the SAME (function, target, horizon, functional-form) cell', counting MARKET-01 in that cell.
correction.why_it_was_wrong: MARKET-01's frozen primary claim is materially different from MARKET-05/MARKET-06. Verified against its frozen preregistration on this branch: a qualifying 30m directional impulse, OI expansion plus weak continuation as an episode STATE, a 60m reversal_return outcome (-D * ln(close(T+60m)/close(T)), alternative horizons forbidden), an event/episode design with a 120m span and overlap policy, a stratified two-group OLS candidate-group effect explicitly marked 'not_nested_ols_on_regular_bar_grid', and a Politis-Romano stationary bootstrap over the episode sequence. It is not a 24h direction-aligned adverse-path MAE study and not an additive-incremental-term design on a daily grid.

carried_from_program_instructions_unveri.MARKET-03: EXTERNAL_REPRODUCTION / REPRODUCED_DIRECTION (not a validated internal candidate)

evidence_map.provenance_note: Only MARKET-01 and MARKET-06 artifacts exist on this branch and are verifiable here. MARKET-02..MARKET-05 statuses are carried from program-level instructions seen in session context and are NOT independently verified against artifacts on this branch.

market_06_sealed.reverse_effect_note: The negative pooled relative MAE improvement must NOT be read as evidence of a reverse (contrarian) effect. It is a null result for the preregistered direction; the frozen design was not powered or specified to test the reverse.
market_06_sealed.scientific_conclusion: Absolute BTC perpetual-vs-spot cross-venue dislocation, conditional on BTC's own recent directional and volatility state, did not provide stable incremental information about subsequent 24h direction-aligned adverse-path risk under the frozen MARKET-06 design.

orthogonal_next_regions.DATA_REQUIREMENTS: Long-history CORE BTC OHLC only. No new acquisition.
orthogonal_next_regions.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: HIGH and symmetric: a positive result supplies a conditioning variable for every later region; a negative result retires a large class of regime-conditional designs.
orthogonal_next_regions.INFORMATION_SOURCE: BTC own price-path second-order structure (volatility-of-volatility, realized-vol term structure, path roughness) over multi-day windows
orthogonal_next_regions.POINT_IN_TIME_FEASIBILITY: HIGH -- as-of computable from completed bars with the existing bar-end semantics.
orthogonal_next_regions.TARGET: Existence and out-of-sample persistence of a discrete market state label; validated by label persistence and transition-rate stability, NOT by forecasting any return or excursion magnitude
orthogonal_next_regions.WHAT_NEGATIVE_RESULT_WOULD_ELIMINATE: If state labels show persistence and transition rates indistinguishable from a matched shuffled/synthetic-path baseline, the premise that BTC has detectable persistent structural regimes at this granularity is eliminated -- which would also weaken every conditional hypothesis that implicitly assumes regime structure.
orthogonal_next_regions.WHY_DISTINCT_FROM_M01_M06: M01/M05/M06 all forecast a scalar risk magnitude at a fixed 24h horizon from a single-instant observable. This region forecasts nothing: it asks whether a persistent state exists at all. A null here is about the existence of regime structure, not about any predictor's incremental value.
orthogonal_next_regions.name: STRUCTURAL_REGIME_STATE_DETECTION

orthogonal_next_regions.DATA_REQUIREMENTS: Existing retained datasets; but the 2022-2024 window is now consumed for M06's target and would need a fresh window or explicit consumption accounting.
orthogonal_next_regions.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: HIGH: directly tests whether the M01-M06 nulls were about the observables or about the mean-linear functional used to interrogate them.
orthogonal_next_regions.INFORMATION_SOURCE: Any already-available observable, including ones that were null as additive linear predictors (OI, dislocation, cross-asset state)
MANDATORY_DESIGN_CONSTRAINTS: The 2022-2024 window consumed by MARKET-06 must not be reused for this target; a fresh window or independent data is required.
Observable choice and any threshold must be selected OUTCOME-BLIND and frozen before evaluation.
No post-hoc selection of whichever previously-null observable happens to look best; the candidate set and selection rule must be preregistered.
Abstention rate must be matched against the random-abstention control by construction, not tuned after seeing results.
orthogonal_next_regions.MECHANISM_FAMILY: Filtering / abstention on an existing exposure schedule
orthogonal_next_regions.NOT_A_CLEAN_DECOMPOSITION_OF_M01_M06: This region must NOT be described as decomposing all MARKET-01..MARKET-06 nulls. Those studies did not share one functional: MARKET-01 used a 60m reversal_return stratified two-group estimand, not a mean-MAE incremental regression. R-B speaks only to observables that were null as incremental mean/scalar predictors.
orthogonal_next_regions.TARGET: Change in the UPPER TAIL (e.g. 90th/95th percentile) of the adverse-path distribution under abstention, benchmarked against random abstention matched on abstention rate
orthogonal_next_regions.WHAT_NEGATIVE_RESULT_WOULD_ELIMINATE: If no available observable beats rate-matched random abstention on the tail, the 'use a signal to decline exposure' mechanism is eliminated for that observable set and that tail functional.
orthogonal_next_regions.WHY_DISTINCT_FROM_M01_M06: Tests whether observables that failed as incremental MEAN/SCALAR predictors may nonetheless carry useful TAIL-SELECTION / ABSTENTION information. This is a different functional of the joint distribution (tail under selection, versus mean under an additive model) and a different decision (decline exposure, versus forecast a magnitude).
orthogonal_next_regions.name: CONDITIONAL_ABSTENTION_RISK_REDUCTION

orthogonal_next_regions.DATA_REQUIREMENTS: Multi-instrument OHLC panel; a genuinely new acquisition unit, but from the same already-reachable archive family as the M06 Binance leg.
orthogonal_next_regions.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: HIGH: the single largest untested structural axis, and the only one that materially increases effective N.
orthogonal_next_regions.INFORMATION_SOURCE: Panel of liquid perpetuals (not BTC alone): cross-sectional dispersion, relative positioning, relative realized volatility
orthogonal_next_regions.MECHANISM_FAMILY: Cross-sectional / relative ordering across a universe of instruments
orthogonal_next_regions.POINT_IN_TIME_FEASIBILITY: MEDIUM -- requires per-instrument listing-date and survivorship handling, which is a real and explicit design risk.
orthogonal_next_regions.TARGET: Stability of a cross-sectional ORDERING (which instruments are relatively more exposed), not any absolute BTC quantity
orthogonal_next_regions.WHAT_NEGATIVE_RESULT_WOULD_ELIMINATE: If cross-sectional orderings are unstable out of sample after controlling for the common factor, the whole relative-value family is eliminated, including pair/basket constructions.
orthogonal_next_regions.WHY_DISTINCT_FROM_M01_M06: Every M01-M06 target was BTC's own absolute state, one row per day, effective N bounded by ~1000 daily decisions. A panel design changes the N-structure entirely (instruments x time), and relative ordering can be stable even when every instrument's absolute level is unpredictable.
orthogonal_next_regions.name: CROSS_SECTIONAL_RELATIVE_STRUCTURE

orthogonal_next_regions.DATA_REQUIREMENTS: L2/trade-level data. Historical depth is sparse and costly; this most likely requires FORWARD collection, which connects directly to FORWARD_MARKET_OBSERVABILITY_V1.
orthogonal_next_regions.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: HIGH per unit of evidence, but gated behind a real acquisition blocker; its main near-term value is deciding whether forward collection is worth committing to.
orthogonal_next_regions.INFORMATION_SOURCE: Order-book depth and resilience, quote intensity, trade-size distribution, queue dynamics
orthogonal_next_regions.POINT_IN_TIME_FEASIBILITY: LOW for history, HIGH for forward collection. Honest expectation: a long lead time before any confirmatory test is possible.
orthogonal_next_regions.TARGET: Liquidity state, and whether it conditions the distribution of subsequent path behaviour
orthogonal_next_regions.WHAT_NEGATIVE_RESULT_WOULD_ELIMINATE: If observed liquidity state carries no conditioning information, the common assumption that microstructure fragility is the mechanism behind adverse excursions is eliminated -- which would retire a large body of informal reasoning.
orthogonal_next_regions.WHY_DISTINCT_FROM_M01_M06: M01 (open interest), M05 (ETH price z-score) and M06 (perp-vs-spot price ratio) are all functions of prices or aggregate positioning. None observed actual liquidity. This is a different DATA TIER, not a different formula over the same tier.
orthogonal_next_regions.name: LIQUIDITY_AND_MARKET_STRUCTURE_STATE

orthogonal_next_regions.DATA_REQUIREMENTS: Trade and quote data; overlaps R-D's acquisition.
orthogonal_next_regions.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: MEDIUM-HIGH, and notably: a POSITIVE result here is not an edge claim. It is a cost model, which constrains what any other region must clear to matter.
orthogonal_next_regions.INFORMATION_SOURCE: Spread, depth at touch, trade intensity, time-of-day and session structure
orthogonal_next_regions.TARGET: Realized execution cost (effective spread paid, slippage versus arrival price) conditional on observable state
orthogonal_next_regions.WHAT_NEGATIVE_RESULT_WOULD_ELIMINATE: If execution cost is not conditionally predictable from contemporaneous liquidity state, then any future mechanism whose edge is smaller than cost dispersion is untestable in practice -- an important feasibility boundary for the whole program.
orthogonal_next_regions.WHY_DISTINCT_FROM_M01_M06: No M01-M06 hypothesis touched execution. All asked WHETHER to be exposed; none asked what exposure COSTS. The causal distance between observable and outcome is far shorter here, so a stable relationship is structurally more plausible -- a statement about mechanism proximity, not about profitability.
orthogonal_next_regions.name: EXECUTION_COST_MECHANISM

orthogonal_next_regions.DATA_REQUIREMENTS: Existing observables; but the 2022-2024 holdout is CONSUMED and must not be reused for a composed variant of the same target.
orthogonal_next_regions.EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN: MEDIUM, and this region carries the HIGHEST RESCUE RISK in the set. It is listed for coverage completeness, with an explicit warning: it is adjacent to a MARKET-06 rescue and must never be selected as a way to re-interrogate the same target on the same consumed window.
orthogonal_next_regions.INFORMATION_SOURCE: Joint configuration of several individually-null observables (OI expansion, cross-venue dislocation, cross-asset state)
orthogonal_next_regions.MECHANISM_FAMILY: Composed multi-observable state (interaction structure, not additive terms)
orthogonal_next_regions.POINT_IN_TIME_FEASIBILITY: HIGH mechanically, LOW governance-wise without a fresh window.
orthogonal_next_regions.TARGET: To be defined by its own preregistration; must NOT default to 24h direction-aligned MAE
orthogonal_next_regions.WHAT_NEGATIVE_RESULT_WOULD_ELIMINATE: A null closes the stronger claim that this observable set is uninformative in ANY low-order composition, which is the honest generalisation the individual nulls cannot support.
orthogonal_next_regions.WHY_DISTINCT_FROM_M01_M06: M01/M05/M06 each tested ONE observable as an ADDITIVE LINEAR term. The open question those nulls do not answer is whether the observables carry no information at all, or carry none additively-and-linearly-alone. Composition is the explicit object of study here.
orthogonal_next_regions.name: COMPOSED_JOINT_STATE_NON_ADDITIVE

ranking_note: Regions are deliberately NOT ordered by expected profitability. They are selected for SEARCH-SPACE COVERAGE and INFORMATION GAIN: a region earns its place when BOTH outcomes are informative about the space.

explicitly_not_disproven: open interest as an information source
saturated_region.explicitly_not_disproven_note: Each was tested in a small number of functional forms against a small number of targets. Nothing here licenses a claim that these information families or mechanism classes are uninformative.

evidence_carried.MARKET-05: NO_EVIDENCE (cross-asset ETH confirmation) [unverified on this branch]

level_1_exact_cell.exact_description: one external/cross-market observable -> additive incremental term alongside BTC own-state controls -> 24h direction-aligned adverse-path prediction -> evaluated by holdout MAE improvement
level_1_exact_cell.honest_limit: Two nulls, one of which is unverified on this branch. This supports deprioritisation, not a claim that the cell is exhausted or that its members are false.
level_1_exact_cell.market_01_exclusion_reason: different outcome (60m reversal_return vs 24h direction-aligned MAE), different design (event/episode vs daily grid), different estimand (stratified two-group OLS candidate-group effect vs additive incremental regressor), different resampling (stationary bootstrap over episodes vs 14-day circular MBB).
level_1_exact_cell.name: EXACT_OR_NEAR_EXACT_NARROW_CELL

members_with_recorded_failures: MARKET-01 (OI expansion + weak continuation -> 60m reversal_return) [verified, sealed]
MARKET-05 (cross-asset -> 24h adverse path) [unverified on this branch]
relevant earlier H / B2 families already recorded in program history
level_2_broader_family.name: SHORT_HORIZON_BTC_CONDITIONAL_SCALAR_PREDICTION
level_2_broader_family.nature_of_conclusion: A PROGRAM-LEVEL SEARCH-PRIORITY conclusion. It is NOT a claim that every member of the family is false, and it is not a statistical result about the family.
level_2_broader_family.reason: Many nearby formulations, across different observables and several short-horizon scalar targets, have repeatedly failed to produce robust incremental evidence.
